title: Bull Case on Jumia Earnings | Africa's Amazon Moment

excerpts.label: Q4 metrics: 34% revenue, 36% GMV, 50% Nigeria
excerpts.insight: Strong top-line growth across all metrics despite stock selling off 16%
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY the dip. Market pricing breakeven miss, not business deterioration. Revenue/GMV/orders all accelerating—this is growth, not survival mode.

excerpts.label: Operating leverage inflection: fulfillment cost falling
excerpts.insight: Fulfillment cost per order declining while revenue/GMV/orders rising—classic marketplace density payoff
excerpts.pm_takeaway: CORE THESIS INTACT. Fulfillment cost/order falling = operating leverage inflection. This is the Amazon playbook—scale into profitability, don't shrink to breakeven.

excerpts.label: Cash burn context: $1.7M immaterial for growth profile
excerpts.insight: $1.7M quarterly burn for small-cap growing 30%+ with falling unit costs = near-profitability
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Ignore breakeven timing noise. $1.7M burn negligible vs 30%+ growth + improving unit economics. Path to profitability clear—patience required, not panic.

excerpts.label: Technical unwind vs fundamental reality
excerpts.insight: Stock drop driven by positioning (breakeven expectations), not deteriorating business. Long-term thesis unchanged.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Entry opportunity for patient capital. Multi-year Africa e-commerce monopoly thesis + operating leverage inflection = 3-5x base case. Watch Nigeria metrics + fulfillment cost trend.
